name: Ricochet Tanks
hook: Bank shots in a maze. Watch out for your own.
how: Drive a tiny tank through a new maze every round. Shells bounce off the walls, and they can come back for you. Grab a laser, a triple shot or a shield. Last tank rolling takes the round; first to five wins.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to drive, Space to fire, or a thumb stick with a Fire button
uses: The players with the most match wins.
The host's browser calls each round, keeps score, picks the maze seed and hands out power-ups; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the empty seats: they find their way through the maze, dodge shells and sometimes bank a shot off the walls.
Every tank and every bouncing shell shows up on all screens at once.
ideas: Add a mine you can drop behind your tank
Make the maze bigger, with more players
Give shells a trail of fire and a louder bang
